title: R595 supervised rehearsal + supervised-auto promotion evidence (Section 16.2; D-010-R104)
objective: Design, execute, and independently review the R595 supervised rehearsal that live-actuates the rotation seam (the R593 accepted residual) with full audit evidence, then assemble the Section 16.2 promotion-evidence pack (tests, replay, crash simulation, context rotation, child cleanup, GitHub push/PR/merge, stale-SHA rejection, secret scan, branch-protection verification, rollback, owner-touch count) for the shadow-to-supervised-auto step; bounded - not an open-ended supervisor-development project (R104).
business_reason: R595 is the mandatory blocking prerequisite before ANY activation (M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST; D-007-R619; D-010-R104); AD-074/AD-076 require staged promotion with evidence.
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): the R595 supervised rehearsal live-actuates the rotation seam in a real supervised run (threshold reached, rotation at the safe seam, children quiesced, digest-verified handoff) with the complete audit trail preserved and independently reviewed; the R593 residual is closed by evidence, never by waiver (D-007-R621).

AS-2 (executable): the Section 16.2 promotion-evidence pack links every listed proof (tests, replay, crash simulation, context rotation, child cleanup, GitHub push/PR/merge, stale-SHA rejection, secret scan, branch-protection verification, rollback, owner-touch count) to reproducible evidence.

AS-3 (executable): the pack claims at most shadow-to-supervised-auto readiness; limited-auto remains gated on its own evidence including two real product tasks; the pack states this explicitly (no activation overclaim).
risks: Rehearsal needs a real supervised run window - bounded by design; if it cannot complete in one unit, split (D-010-R103) rather than extend open-endedly (R104).
